name: cogniforge-ar
description: COGNIFORGE AR -- handheld augmented-reality use on a phone. Android launches straight into NativeArActivity: a native ARCore + hand-written OpenGL renderer with real camera passthrough and hit-test surface placement (Capacitor's WebView cannot run WebXR's immersive-ar session at all, which is why this bypasses it entirely). iOS has no ARCore equivalent, so it falls back to the Capacitor WebView running the AR-tailored frontend build's head-tracking parallax mode, since Safari does not implement WebXR either.

scripts.sync: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync
